project.name: OR Solar 7 (Jackson County)
project.land_class: EFU; high-value irrigated farmland, majority Class I soils; adjacent to the Medford urban growth boundary

reasons.label: Goal exception criteria not met or met
reasons.quote: establish a general requirement to utilize renewable resources, including the in-[s]tate siting of renewable energy production facilities such as the proposed project
reasons.note: County finding supporting the Goal 3 exception: Goal 13 creates a 'demonstrated need' (first of two alternative bases for approval), quoted by LUBA. LUBA rejected it.

reasons.label: Goal exception criteria not met or met
reasons.quote: The proximity of Sage Substation provides a significant comparative advantage, would benefit the local economy, and as approved, does not involve a loss of resource lands.
reasons.note: County finding 2.6 supporting the exception as rural industrial development (second of two alternative bases for approval), quoted by LUBA in a footnote. LUBA and later the Court of Appeals rejected it.

reasons.label: Other / not yet coded
reasons.quote: The development will also result in a significant increase in the tax revenues received by the County for the subject property. Thus, the proposed project will benefit the local economy.
reasons.note: County finding on local economic benefit (part of finding 2.6), quoted by LUBA in a footnote. Economic benefit does not fit an existing category; likely recurring in approvals, so a candidate for a new category.

proceedings.body: Oregon Land Use Board of Appeals

reasons.label: Goal exception criteria not met or met
reasons.quote: the county erred in concluding that Goal 13 includes a requirement to promote the development of renewable energy such as the proposed solar facility
reasons.note: LUBA reason for reversing: Goal 13 imposes no requirement to promote renewable energy, so no 'demonstrated need' exception. The 2019 remand opinion reverses 'for the reasons explained in our prior decision, as modified by the Court of Appeals', so this ground is taken as standing (the Court of Appeals opinion is not in the sample set).

proceedings.body: Oregon Land Use Board of Appeals (on remand from the Court of Appeals)

reasons.label: Goal exception criteria not met or met
reasons.quote: it concluded that the solar facility was not "industrial development" for purposes of OAR 660-004-0022(3)(c)
reasons.note: Court of Appeals reasoning, as reported by LUBA on remand, for reversing the rural-industrial basis. The Court of Appeals disagreed with LUBA's 2017 reasoning on the urban substation, so that ground is not coded.

project.name: Silver Creek Solar (Marion County CU 22-041)
project.land_class: FT (Farm/Timber) zone; high-value farmland by soil type; Christmas trees

reasons.label: State farmland-use standards not met
reasons.quote: not provided sufficient evidence to satisfy the criteria required by OAR 660-033-0130(38).
reasons.note: County board's ground for denial, as summarized by LUBA.

reasons.label: No local code authority for the use
reasons.quote: Without the criteria of MCC 17.120.110, a photo voltaic solar power generation facility cannot be approved in Marion County on high-value soils.
reasons.note: County board's finding, quoted by LUBA (Record 35-36).

reasons.label: No local code authority for the use
reasons.quote: Since the County removed those standards from its code and removed the provisions for allowing solar arrays as a conditional use, there is not a means to permit solar arrays on farmland.
reasons.note: Planning staff recommendation to the hearings officer (Dec 8, 2022), not the final decision.

proceedings.body: Oregon Land Use Board of Appeals

reasons.label: State farmland-use standards not met
reasons.quote: pursuant to ORS 197.646(3), OAR 660-033-0130(38) applies directly, notwithstanding ORS 215.416(8).
reasons.note: LUBA reason for affirming: state rule applies directly because the county repealed its implementing code.

reasons.label: State farmland-use standards not met
reasons.quote: We conclude that LCDC did not exceed its statutory authority by adopting regulations that apply to high-value farmland in a mixed-use zone.
reasons.note: LUBA reason for affirming (third assignment of error).

project.name: Yamhill Creek Solar
project.land_class: EFU (EF-80); high-value farmland (Yamhill-Carlton Viticulture Area); about 12 percent high-value soils

reasons.label: Loss of productive or high-value farmland
reasons.quote: soil compaction and herbicide use over the life of the facility could adversely impact the soils for agricultural use after the facility is decommissioned
reasons.note: County finding under the plan's soil-resources goal (Agricultural Lands Goal 2), as summarized by LUBA. LUBA found it supported by substantial evidence (p.25). Replaces an earlier quote from the state soil standard, which LUBA did not review. The county's Goal 2 finding had three concerns; this quote is the third (compaction and herbicide use). LUBA also upheld the second (chemical runoff or aluminum leaching), calling the two alternative bases for the county's conclusion; that second concern is not coded separately. LUBA found no evidence for the first (heavy construction and shading) but held that did not matter (pdf pp.24-26).

reasons.label: Visual, scenic or tourism-economy impacts
reasons.quote: The open space character is not insured by the industrialization that would occur if this proposal were approved.
reasons.note: County board finding on open space and aesthetic qualities (gateway to the viticulture area), quoted by LUBA.

reasons.label: Visual, scenic or tourism-economy impacts
reasons.quote: is not in the short or long-term economic interest of the county
reasons.note: LUBA summarizing the county's economic-development finding: siting solar on high-value farmland, citing testimony on harm to the tourism and wine industries.

reasons.label: Other / not yet coded
reasons.quote: the industrial use is proposed outside the urban growth boundary, in an undesirable location, without an adequate buffer to prevent adverse impacts to surrounding properties
reasons.note: County board finding under industrial-development plan policies, quoted by LUBA. Siting outside an urban growth boundary and lack of buffer to neighbors does not fit an existing category; candidate for a new one.

reasons.label: Loss of productive or high-value farmland
reasons.quote: The county further balances the Comprehensive Plan goals and policies in favor of farmland protection because a solar facility can be located on non-farmland.
reasons.note: County board's final weighing under YCZO 1202.02(B), quoted by LUBA: alternative sites on non-farmland were available. The same section's overall 'on balance' conclusion restates the individual findings and is not coded separately.

proceedings.body: Oregon Land Use Board of Appeals

reasons.label: Other / not yet coded
reasons.quote: the county's ultimate conclusion that the balance of the applicable goals and policies weigh against the proposed use is not reversible on appeal.
reasons.note: LUBA reason for affirming: deference to the county's weighing of plan policies (ORS 197.829(1)); LUBA did not address the other grounds for denial. Appeal-level reason; possible 'deferential review' category.
